title: CALL ... USING BY CONTENT — copy on call; protects the caller from callee mutation
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. SAFE-CALL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-INPUT  PIC X(20).
       01  WS-MSG    PIC X(40).
      *> BY CONTENT makes a defensive COPY before the call. The
      *> callee sees its own buffer; mutating it leaves WS-INPUT
      *> untouched. Modern Java rewrites usually default to BY
      *> CONTENT semantic for Strings (immutable) but reset to
      *> BY REFERENCE for mutable records -- the spec must capture
      *> which one the legacy used.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           CALL "FORMAT-MSG" USING BY CONTENT WS-INPUT, WS-MSG.
notes: BY CONTENT signals 'this is an input, don't mutate'. The spec must capture which parameters are BY CONTENT vs BY REFERENCE so the rewrite preserves the contract.
